summary: Master smart home real estate integration. Learn IoT protocols, PropTech ROI, and smart building valuation to increase asset value. Enroll today.
lede: Smart home technology in real estate helps property professionals assess connected systems and plan practical upgrades. Designed for property, asset, facilities, development and technology professionals, the course covers device compatibility, network planning, automation design and cybersecurity risk controls. You’ll also practice preparing a property readiness snapshot and a business case for smart upgrades, while considering maintenance, tenant adoption and portfolio priorities.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to evaluate, integrate, and communicate smart home technology decisions in real estate environments.
prerequisites: Participants should have working knowledge of residential or commercial property operations, basic home networking concepts such as TCP/IP, and familiarity with smart home platforms such as Home Assistant, Apple HomeKit, Google Home, or Amazon Alexa. Prior exposure to electrical, low-voltage, facilities, or property technology environments is helpful. No coding is required, although you should be comfortable reviewing dashboards, device specifications, and implementation plans.
